project.name: Local Marketplace
project.description: A small neighborhood marketplace where people list used items with photos and mark them sold when claimed locally.
project.problem: People in the neighborhood have no shared, low-effort place to sell or buy used items without going through big platforms.
goals: List an item with photos in under a minute
successCriteria: A user can publish a listing and another user can mark it as sold/claimed
userStories: As a resident, I can photograph a bookshelf and list it with a price.

features.name: Listing marketplace
features.description: Create, browse, and mark listings as sold.

features.name: Photo uploads
features.description: Attach up to 5 photos per listing.

requirements.title: Users can create a listing with photos and a price
requirements.description: Listings have a title, price, category, up to 5 photos, and a sold flag.

requirements.title: Users can browse and filter listings
requirements.description: Filter by category and sort by newest.

requirements.title: Photos are resized and stored efficiently
requirements.description: Generate thumbnails on upload to keep the gallery fast.

decisions.decision: No in-app payments in v1 — hand off to cash or external transfer.
decisions.reason: Payment processing is out of scope for a local marketplace.

assumptions.statement: Listings are public but require a user account to create.

security.accessControl: Only the listing owner can edit or mark sold; anyone can view public listings.

acceptanceCriteria: A created listing is visible to others and can be marked sold by the owner only
